h1: Office Interior Design & Custom Furniture, 500 m²

blocks.text: Office Interior Design & Custom Furniture, 500 m²

DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed the interior design project for a 500 m² office and designed and manufactured custom office furniture specifically for the project. The office space was planned with a focus on functional zoning, workplace ergonomics and a contemporary professional environment. Particular attention was given to employee work areas, executive offices, meeting spaces, reception and the conference room. The project included the design and production of custom office furniture, including wall panels, employee and executive desks, a conference table, cabinets, storage units, reception furniture, conference room furniture and furniture for the director’s office. Tailor-made furniture allowed every element to be integrated into the architecture of the space while maintaining a consistent interior concept. The page features 3D visualizations of the project as well as video of the completed interior and manufactured furniture, demonstrating the final result of the comprehensive approach to the office space. DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides office and commercial interior design, custom furniture design and manufacturing in Bratislava and Vienna. We develop comprehensive solutions for offices, corporate spaces and other commercial interiors — from space planning and interior concepts to technical documentation and individually designed furniture.
